title: Clinic appointment booking
tagline: Back-to-back slots clash, one doctor blocks another, and cancelled slots stay taken.
lookFor: Two times overlap only if `a.start < b.end && b.start < a.end`. Use `<`, so touching doesn't count.
Only check against the SAME doctor.
Leave cancelled bookings out of the check.
Check that start is before end.

bugs.symptom: Dr. Rao can't take a slot Dr. Iyer has booked
hints: Which bookings does the clash check load?
bugs.cause: It loads all bookings, not just this doctor's.

bugs.symptom: A cancelled slot still can't be rebooked
hints: Does the check look at status?
bugs.cause: Cancelled bookings are still treated as taken.

bugs.symptom: Hidden test: end before start is accepted
bugs.fix: `if (!(Number.isInteger(start) && Number.isInteger(end) && start < end)) throw new HttpError(400, ...)`
